title: docs-kit site.yaml
description: Content contract for a consuming project's docs/site.yaml: everything the docs site needs that is not a docs page.

name.description: Project name as shown in the site title and landing hero. Usually the binary or repository name.

tagline.description: One sentence under the name on the landing hero and in the site meta description: what the project is and for whom.

eyebrow.description: Short label above the landing hero title, e.g. the project category.

description.description: Paragraph under the landing hero title, one to three sentences; renders `inline code`. Defaults to 'tagline'.

theme.description: Design theme, one of the CSS token files shipped in packages/starlight-kit/themes/<name>.css. Changes look only, never layout.

logo.description: Project logo shown next to the site title. Paths are relative to the docs directory and start with './', e.g. './src/assets/logo.svg'. For a favicon, put 'favicon.svg' in the docs directory's public/ folder; 'favicon.ico' and 'apple-touch-icon.png' there are linked too.

light.description: Logo for the light color scheme, and for both schemes when 'dark' is omitted.

dark.description: Logo for the dark color scheme.

art.description: Illustration in the hero, beside the title. When set, the flow panel moves to a section below the hero. Path relative to the docs directory, starting with './'. The SVG is inlined, so its own <style> can animate it and follow the color scheme with :root[data-theme='light'] selectors; it is hidden from screen readers.

repo.description: Repository URL, used for the GitHub link and 'edit this page' links.

domain.description: Custom domain the GitHub Pages site is served at, such as 'example.dev'. The site is then built for the domain root instead of https://<owner>.github.io/<repo>/.

install.description: Install methods in order of preference. The first one is shown on the landing hero with a copy button; all are listed below it.

code.description: Shell command that installs or runs the project, copied verbatim.

features.description: Landing page feature grid: 3 to 6 short selling points, each grounded in what the code actually does.

flow.description: Panel beside the landing hero showing how the project fits with other systems: one row per connection.

title.description: Panel heading. Defaults to 'How it fits'.

highlight.description: Node name drawn filled, usually the project itself.

label.description: What travels between them, a few words.

arrow.description: Arrow direction between from and to.

note.description: One sentence under the rows; renders `inline code`.

art.description: Illustration drawn in place of the rows, which stay for screen readers. Path relative to the docs directory, starting with './'. The SVG is inlined, so its own <style> can animate it and follow the color scheme with :root[data-theme='light'] selectors; it is hidden from screen readers.

diff.description: Landing section showing a change and what it changes in each target, as diffs: one tab per target. For projects whose output is reviewed as a diff; omit otherwise.

title.description: Section heading. Defaults to 'What a change looks like'.

intro.description: One or two sentences under the heading; renders `inline code`.

change.description: The edit a user makes, shown beside the tabs.

label.description: Label above the files. Defaults to 'The change'.

path.description: File path, shown as the title; its extension picks the syntax highlighting.

diff.description: Unified diff lines: '+' added, '-' removed, ' ' context, '@@' hunk headers. No file headers.

label.description: Label above the tabs. Defaults to 'What it changes'.

path.description: File path, shown as the title; its extension picks the syntax highlighting.

diff.description: Unified diff lines: '+' added, '-' removed, ' ' context, '@@' hunk headers. No file headers.

tree.description: Landing section showing an inheritance tree: one tab per node with an `id`, numbering the nodes it inherits from. For projects with layered configuration; omit otherwise.

title.description: Section heading. Defaults to 'How settings inherit'.

intro.description: One or two sentences beside the tree; renders `inline code`.

cascade.description: Landing panel showing one request falling through ordered tiers of backends, with one tab per scenario. For projects that route or fall back between backends; omit otherwise.

title.description: Panel heading. Defaults to 'How a request falls through'.

request.description: The request entering the panel, e.g. 'GET /<hash>.narinfo'; shown as code.

hub.description: The project's own row between the request and the tiers.

body.description: What it does with the request, one short sentence.

tiers.description: Tiers in the order a request tries them.

label.description: Small label above the name, e.g. 'tier 1 · sequential'.

id.description: Key that scenarios use to set this backend's state.

name.description: Shown as code, usually a URL.

scenarios.description: One tab each. A backend a scenario does not mention is shown as not asked.

note.description: One or two sentences under the tiers; renders `inline code`.

states.description: Backend id to its state in this scenario.

state.description: hit: answered; miss: answered without the item; down: skipped as unreachable; idle: not asked.

components.description: Landing section listing the parts the project ships: commands, modules, packages.

intro.description: One or two sentences beside the list; renders `inline code`.

name.description: Name as users type it, shown as code.

links.description: Extra links shown on the landing page, e.g. docs.rs, pkg.go.dev, changelog. Library API docs are linked, never copied.

reference.description: How refgen produces the generated pages under reference/. Omit when the project has no CLI.

cli.description: CLI reference generated by walking '<bin> --help' and every subcommand.

bin.description: Command name as users type it; used for page titles and file names.

build.description: Shell command, run from the repository root, that builds the binary, e.g. 'cargo build --release', 'go build -o bin/x .' or 'nix build'. Requires 'path'.

path.description: Path to the built binary relative to the repository root, e.g. 'target/release/kasha' or 'result/bin/kasha'. When omitted, 'bin' is looked up on PATH.

name.description: Node name, e.g. a directory; shown as code.

file.description: File the node contributes, shown beside the name.

note.description: A few words on what this level sets; renders `inline code`.

id.description: Makes the node a tab: the label of a leaf that inherits from every node above it.
